findings.description: Only one cube is in the hand at 00:00.75 (2 cubes total). By 00:01.00 a second blue cube ('3') is present beside the held blue '2', making 3 cubes. The hand never leaves frame or brings a cube in; the new cube emerges from the held one.

The held green cube splits into two: at 00:03.0 the green cube shows '2' with a blurred '3' bulging out its right side, and by 00:03.25 there are two separate green cubes (2 and 3). Count 3->4 with no cube added.
Between 00:03.75 and 00:04.0 a fifth blurred blue cube appears at the right of the held orange '2' cube; count 4->5 with no visible source.
Between 00:04.75 (5 cubes, hand resting on grey '3') and 00:05.0-05.25 a new blue '3' cube emerges from the right of the grey cube; count 5->6 without any cube being brought in.
Around 00:05.9 the held green '3' cube turns into green '5' and a new green cube splits off its right side; 6->7 cubes by 00:06.0-06.25 with no added cube.
At 00:06.5 there are 7 cubes (last one green '3' held); at 00:06.75 the 7th shows green '2' and an 8th blue '3' cube is present to its right. Count 7->8 with nothing brought in.

Held cubes change body colour while merely being rotated: first cube green->blue (00:00.25-00:00.75), 4th cube green->orange (00:03.5-03.75), 6th cube blue->teal->green (00:05.25-05.75). Cubes appear single-coloured elsewhere, so the colour swaps have no mechanism.
